# NeoORM

> TypeScript-first SQL ORM: schema → codegen → typed client for PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, and MariaDB. You own the SQL; it handles the boilerplate.

## Start here

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, scaffold a project, first migration, Studio.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): `neoorm.config.ts` and datasource setup.
- [Studio](docs/studio.md): local data browser, SQL console, query playground, and schema explorer.

## Schema

- [Schema DSL](docs/schema.md): tables, column types, checks, indexes (including partial), enums, and naming strategies.
- [Schema relations](docs/schema-relations.md): foreign keys, composite keys, self-relations, and many-to-many tables.
- [Plugins](docs/plugins.md): column-type plugins (PostGIS, citext, and custom).

## Queries

- [Queries](docs/queries.md): `findMany`, `findUnique`, `create`, `update`, `delete`, `upsert`, `findOrCreate`.
- [Filters & aggregates](docs/filters.md): where operators, relation filters, offset/cursor pagination, `count`, `aggregate`, `groupBy`.
- [Eager loading & projection](docs/loading.md): `with` planner, `select`/`omit`, `.hidden()`, and `.strip()`.
- [Nested writes](docs/relations.md): nested `connect`, `create`, `disconnect`, `set`, and `delete` writes.
- [Transactions](docs/transactions.md): interactive, batch, nested savepoints, and isolation levels.
- [Raw SQL & logging](docs/raw-sql.md): `db.sql`, `sqlBuilder`, `db.execute`, and `beforeQuery`/`afterQuery`.
- [Common errors](docs/errors.md): error codes, constraint subclasses, and fixes.

## Database & tooling

- [Migrations](docs/migrations.md): `migrate dev`, `deploy`, `diff`, `status`, `down`, `reset`, and `db push`/`pull`.
- [Seeding](docs/seeding.md): `neoorm seed`, environments, idempotent seeds.
- [CLI reference](docs/cli.md): every `neoorm` command and flag.

## Validation

- [Validation](docs/validation.md): compare Zod, TypeBox 1.x, and Elysia `t` schema codegen.
- [Zod schemas](docs/zod.md): Zod 4 validation schemas from the schema.
- [TypeBox schemas](docs/typebox.md): TypeBox 1.x validation schemas from the schema.
- [Elysia schemas](docs/elysia.md): Elysia `t` validation schemas for route bodies and queries.

## Dialects

- [PostgreSQL](docs/postgresql.md): pools, tenant schemas, extensions, JSONB, arrays, ranges, and full-text search.
- [SQLite](docs/sqlite.md): SQLite drivers, configuration, type mapping, and limitations.
- [MySQL](docs/mysql.md): MySQL 8 setup, type mapping, and limitations.
- [MariaDB](docs/mariadb.md): MariaDB 10.11 setup, type mapping, and limitations.

## Guides & contributing

- [Cookbook](docs/examples.md): end-to-end recipes for auth, feeds, soft deletes, search, and PostGIS.
- [API docstring conventions](docs/api-docstrings.md): TSDoc rules for contributors (docstrings ship in IDE hovers and `.d.ts`).
